scope: Recorded runs on the current server; seed 0 only. No aggregate completion percentage or full-equivalence claim.

experts.scope: Current catalogue runtime and original seed-0 expert predicates. Not full physics, visual or performance equivalence.

catalogue.scope: Scene loading and finite PhysX stepping; original controls held at reset values. Does not qualify experts or task success.

assets.scope: SHA-256 of every archived asset and its original source, plus compiled snapshot files. Does not qualify renderer or physics semantics.

renders.scope: Detect missing, flat or incorrectly sized RGB; not visual equivalence.

physics_fixtures.scope: Native joint coupling, compliant closure, catalogue noslip friction and free-joint reset fixtures.

live_visuals.scope: Real web-launched engine rendering, original dynamic display drawing and original liquid-state surface graphics; no full fluid or pixel equivalence claim.

visual_inspection.scope: Actual final wrist-camera frames. Source and Isaac lighting/material response remain different.

performance.scope: Wall times include startup, controller, IPC, logging and rendering where named; not an isolated physics benchmark.
